OpenDuckFrame 0.2.1

  • 默认配置使用“跟随来源”，恢复旧默认配置时也会纠正残留的全屏观看状态。
  • 修复修改“来源窗口尺寸”时自动切换到“全屏观看”、导致网页鼠标操作被阻挡的问题。
  • 来源窗口尺寸和超分输出尺寸继续按原规则生效；其他配置中明确保存的观看或交互模式保持原选择。

使用“跟随来源”时，增强画面与原窗口对齐，可直接操作网页。需要全屏观看时仍可手动选择；全屏观看模式不转发鼠标输入。

English

The default preset now reopens in Follow source mode, including when an older default configuration retained Fullscreen viewer. Changing the source window size no longer silently selects Fullscreen viewer and blocks webpage clicks. Source resizing and scaler output-size behavior are preserved. Explicit modes in other saved configurations are preserved.

This community build is ad-hoc signed, supports signed in-app updates, and is not Apple notarized. Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.

OpenDuckFrame 0.2.0

  • For supported window sources, choose a source window size before scaling. The selected window is resized before capture; for the video itself to match the selected size, it must fill that window.
  • Improve single-window capture when child windows extend beyond the selected window.
  • Use frame generation and scaling separately or together, subject to the selected engines' compatibility.
  • Press Esc to leave fullscreen viewer and return to the source-aligned view; apply again to re-enter.

Window resizing requires Accessibility permission and a resizable window. Available engines and output sizes depend on the system and hardware; results depend on the source and engine.

This community build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized. macOS may block its first launch. If you trust the download, review the app under System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose whether to allow it.

OpenDuckFrame 0.1.3

  • 优化本地 SDR 视频的 RIFE 插帧：复用相邻原帧输入与特征，减少重复色彩转换和计算。
  • 原始帧优先交付；性能不足时保留原视频播放节奏，减少等待造成的延迟。
  • 完善跳转、会话失效和失败回退后的缓存重建与回归检查。

M5 Max、1080p 24 FPS、RIFE 4.25 fast X2 的单次原生播放核心对照中，有效呈现中位数由约 24.1 提升到 48.1 FPS，任务中位耗时减少约 38%。效果取决于设备与片源；M1 Pro 真机尚未验证。

本版本为社区版，使用临时代码签名及签名验证的应用内更新，未经过 Apple 公证。需要 macOS 14 或更高版本及 Apple 芯片。

English

Improves local SDR RIFE interpolation by reusing adjacent source inputs and cached features. Originals are delivered before waiting for synthesis, with bounded waits when the model cannot keep up. Includes regression checks for seeks, cancelled sessions and stream failure recovery.

A single M5 Max native playback-core comparison with 1080p 24 FPS input and RIFE 4.25 fast X2 measured about 24.1 to 48.1 effective presented FPS and a 38% reduction in median job time. Results vary by hardware and media; M1 Pro hardware has not been validated. This community build is ad-hoc signed, supports signed in-app updates, and is not Apple notarized.
